verdict.rationale: The product documents its own bulk-upload process for equity promises, a genuine first-party bulk operation, but the evidence covers only that single item type and gives no detail on how it works. Predefined vesting schedules and the Gusto sync are related conveniences, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit. API probes all returned 404, so there is no programmatic route for AI-driven bulk actions. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond equity promises (e.g., bulk grants, bulk edits, bulk approvals), details on the bulk-upload mechanics and limits, programmatic/API-driven bulk actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: For multiple promises, there is a process to upload equity promises in bulk.
